title: The Sentence Learns to End
label: ch:ur-script-copula
canDo: I can read yih, kaam, kahan, maan and the copula hai off the page rather than from the romanization, write mera naam ... hai from dictation, and put gol he, bari ye and nun ghunna back to work in words I had only heard.

payoff.summary: The copula hai comes off the page, and with it every sentence the reader already knew how to end, including mera naam ... hai, the first sentence the book ever gave them -- built from three letters learned eleven chapters earlier and returned to here.
